LightningComponentBundle.description: Generic kanban board. Any SObject + group-by picklist + display field. Optional drag & drop that updates the group-by field on the record. Whitelisted objects: Case, Opportunity, Lead, Order, Task, Account.

property.name: sobjectApiName
property.label: SObject to query
property.description: Whitelisted: Case | Opportunity | Lead | Order | Task | Account. On a Record Page this drives which object's records are listed (it does NOT follow the host page's object).

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: (deprecated) Object API name
property.description: Legacy alias - use 'SObject to query' above. Kept to avoid breaking existing FlexiPages.

property.name: groupByField
property.label: Group-by field API name
property.description: Picklist field used to form the columns.

property.name: displayField
property.label: Display field API name
property.description: Field shown as the card title.

property.name: amountField
property.label: Amount field (optional)
property.description: Currency / decimal field summed per column, e.g. 'Amount' on Opportunity.

property.name: filterClause
property.label: SOQL WHERE clause (optional)
property.description: Raw SOQL fragment. Leave empty for no filter. Be cautious - injected as-is.

property.name: maxPerColumn
property.label: Max cards visible per column
property.description: Beyond this cap, a 'Show all (N)' link unfolds the column.

property.name: disableDragDrop
property.label: Disable drag & drop
property.description: Off by default - cards are draggable between columns; dropping updates the group-by field.
